verdict.rationale: square-docs-26 confirms Terminal API supports collecting tips via a separate tip input screen and custom tip amounts, directly matching the story's core capability. However, there's no explicit documentation on configuring smart amount suggestions/percentage-based tipping prompts or dashboard-level merchant-ops configuration UI for tip settings on readers. Missing for 10: evidence of percentage-based/smart tip amount configuration, dashboard UI walkthrough for merchant-ops to set tipping options, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the tipping prompt experience.
